europe_now.title: Escalating Student Protests in France
europe_now.summary: Student protests across France have intensified significantly, resulting in over 400 detentions amid reports of fires and blockades. The unrest coincides with broader economic and political pressures facing the French administration.

sources.headline: More than 400 detained as France student protests escalate
Fires and blockades as students stage school protests across France

europe_now.title: European Union Budget Debates and Cuts
europe_now.summary: European governments are bracing for substantial budget adjustments, including potential cuts of €100 billion to the upcoming EU budget proposal. The anticipated reductions have sparked intense debates among member states regarding funding for regional development and agricultural sectors.

sources.headline: Governments brace for €100B cut to EU budget proposal
Frugal EU states seeking budget cuts are shooting their own regions in the foot

top_stories.title: French Public Borrowing and Fiscal Pressures
top_stories.summary: France intends to borrow a record €340 billion as previous debt obligations come due. The massive borrowing requirement highlights the ongoing financial strains facing the nation.

sources.headline: France intends to borrow record €340 billion as Covid-era debt comes due

top_stories.title: UK Energy Infrastructure Security
top_stories.summary: A government minister has warned that critical UK energy infrastructure remains under constant threat. Meanwhile, police investigated a security scare at an airbase after discovering petrol but no explosives.

sources.headline: Mystery over UK airbase scare as police find 'quantity of petrol' but no explosives
UK energy infrastructure under constant threat, minister warns

top_stories.title: Spanish Housing Policy and Eviction Bans
top_stories.summary: Spain has announced a formal ban on evictions following widespread protests. The public outcry was triggered by the removal of an elderly resident from her apartment.

sources.headline: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
